header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: ranks of Jannah.” Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا صَلَّي الْفَجْرَ تَرَبَّعَ فِي مَجْلِسِهِ حَتَّي تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ حَسْنَاءَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في الرجل يجلس متربعا رقم:٤٨٥٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Jabir ibn Samurah (RA) narrates, “After the Fajr Salah, Rasulullah ﷺ would sit cross-legged until the sun had fully risen.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: لأَنْ أَقْعُدَ مَعَ قَوْمٍ يَذْكُرُونَ اللهَ تَعَالَي مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْغَدَاةِ حَتَّي تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُعْتِقَ أَرْبَعَةً مِنْ وُلْدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَلأَنْ أَقْعُدَ مَعَ قَوْمٍ يَذْكُرُونَ اللهَ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ إِلَي أَنْ تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُعْتِقَ أَرْبَعَةً.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في القصص رقم: ٣٦٦٧
blocks.tamil_translation: “For me to sit with a group who do the Dhikr of Allah after the Subh Salah until the sun rises is more beloved to me than freeing four slaves from the descendants of Hazrat Isma'il (AS). Likewise, for me to sit with a group who do the Dhikr of Allah after the Asr Salah until the sun sets is more beloved to me than freeing four slaves from the descendants of Hazrat Isma'il (AS).” Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.text: Explanation:- That is, the descendants of Hazrat Isma'il (AS) were of high value because they were the best and most honourable of the Arab lineage.
